title: Music, video & games
blurb: Streaming, Spotify, video files, game launchers.

remedies.title: A video file won't play ("unsupported format" or no picture)
remedies.why: The video uses a format or codec the built-in player doesn't handle (HEVC, MKV, AVI).

steps.text: Install the free HEVC/AV1 extensions from the Microsoft Store, or use VLC (plays almost everything).
Use VLC or IINA for MKV and other formats QuickTime refuses.
Avoid "codec pack" downloads from unknown sites.

remedies.title: Netflix, YouTube or Disney+ keeps buffering
remedies.why: The connection can't keep up with the quality, or the browser struggles.

steps.text: Run a speed test; 4K needs ~25 Mbps, HD ~5 Mbps.
Lower the quality in the player, or close other downloads.
Use the service's own app or Edge/Safari for higher quality streams.

remedies.title: Spotify or music app won't play or keeps stopping
remedies.why: Another device took over playback, the app's cache is full, or the sound output changed.

steps.text: Check the Connect/devices icon: playback may be on your phone or speaker.
Log out on all devices (account page) if it keeps pausing.
Pick the right sound output.
Pick the right sound output.
Reinstall the app to clear its cache.

remedies.title: Steam, Epic or Xbox app won't launch a game
remedies.why: Damaged game files, missing runtimes, or antivirus blocking the game.

steps.text: Verify/repair the game files (Steam: Properties › Installed Files › Verify).
Update graphics drivers.
Xbox app/Store games: Reset the Gaming Services and Store.
Check the game's Mac/Windows requirements.

remedies.title: Cast or AirPlay to a TV or Chromecast
remedies.why: TVs accept AirPlay (Apple), Google Cast (Chrome) or Miracast (Windows).

steps.text: Chromecast/Google TV: Chrome › ⋮ › Cast. Same Wi-Fi needed.
Miracast TVs: Windows+K.
AirPlay TVs/Apple TV: Control Center › Screen Mirroring.
Guest or office Wi-Fi often blocks casting; a HDMI cable always works.

remedies.title: Photos app doesn't show my pictures
remedies.why: The Photos app only shows folders it's told about, or a different library.

steps.text: Photos › Folders › Add a folder.
Hold Option while opening Photos to choose the right library.
